MANUAL.label: Manual Tool
MANUAL.chipText: Needs a person to operate it

levels.title: Level 1: Warm-Up Signals
levels.description: Clear examples to establish the three categories.

cards.title: Face Unlock
cards.hint: AI learns facial patterns from camera data to verify your identity.

cards.title: Voice Assistant
cards.hint: AI learns speech patterns to recognize words and answer questions.

cards.title: Video Recommendations
cards.hint: AI learns your viewing habits and patterns from what you watch.

cards.title: Photo App Face Grouping
cards.hint: AI learns and recognizes visual patterns to group similar faces together.

cards.title: Microwave Timer
cards.hint: Rule set in advance: counts down the exact minutes or seconds set.

cards.title: Automatic Door Sensor
cards.hint: Fixed rule: whenever motion detector triggers, open the door.

cards.title: Washing Machine Cycle
cards.hint: Fixed rule: runs a predetermined sequence of wash, rinse, and spin.

cards.title: Street Light at 6 PM
cards.hint: Fixed timer: turns on every day at the clock time programmed in advance.

cards.title: Bicycle
cards.reason: Needs a person to operate it
cards.hint: Does nothing on its own; a person must pedal and steer it.

cards.title: Pencil Sharpener
cards.reason: Needs a person to operate it
cards.hint: Manual tool: requires a human hand to insert and twist the pencil.

cards.title: Paper Map
cards.reason: Needs a person to operate it
cards.hint: Static paper; a person must read and find the route themselves.

cards.title: Hand Fan
cards.reason: Needs a person to operate it
cards.hint: Manual tool: does nothing unless a person waves it back and forth.

levels.title: Level 2: Hidden Signals
levels.description: AI features hidden inside everyday apps.

cards.title: Email Spam Filter
cards.hint: AI learns patterns from millions of messages to spot junk emails.

cards.title: Next-Word Prediction
cards.hint: AI learns typing habits and grammar patterns to predict words.

cards.title: Map Arrival Time
cards.hint: AI learns from live traffic data patterns to estimate arrival time.

cards.title: Shop 'You May Also Like'
cards.hint: AI analyzes shopper purchase data to recommend relevant items.

cards.title: Language Translation App
cards.hint: AI learns language patterns and context across bilingual texts.

cards.title: Calculator App
cards.hint: Fixed rule: applies predetermined mathematical arithmetic rules.

cards.title: Phone Alarm Clock
cards.hint: Fixed timer: triggers sound when the clock matches the scheduled hour.

cards.title: Vending Machine
cards.hint: Fixed rule: if inserted money matches price, dispense chosen snack.

cards.title: Fixed Timer Traffic Light
cards.hint: Fixed timer: switches red, yellow, green on a programmed clock loop.

cards.title: Flashlight Switch
cards.reason: Needs a person to operate it
cards.hint: Manual tool: simply opens or closes an electrical contact when clicked.

cards.title: Paper Dictionary
cards.reason: Needs a person to operate it
cards.hint: Manual tool: printed book requiring a human to flip pages and search.

cards.title: Scissors
cards.reason: Needs a person to operate it
cards.hint: Manual tool: two blades joined by a pivot that require hands to cut.

levels.title: Level 3: Same Device, Different Feature
levels.description: Look at the feature, not the whole device!

cards.title: Speaker: Voice Recognition
cards.hint: AI learns acoustic patterns to recognize who is speaking.

cards.title: Speaker: Volume Button
cards.reason: Needs a person to operate it
cards.hint: Manual control: does nothing until a human finger presses it.

cards.title: Thermostat: Learns Schedule
cards.hint: AI learns your living habits and presence patterns to adjust heat.

cards.title: Thermostat: Fixed Timer
cards.hint: Fixed rule: changes temperature at the exact programmed clock hours.

cards.title: Game: Adapting Difficulty
cards.hint: AI learns from player skill data and adapts the gameplay challenge.

cards.title: Game: Scripted Enemy Path
cards.hint: Fixed rule: enemy patrols a hard-coded path regardless of player data.

cards.title: Camera: Portrait Blur
cards.hint: AI learns visual contours from image data to separate subject from background.

cards.title: Camera: Flash in Dark
cards.hint: Fixed rule: if photo light level is below a threshold, turn on flash.

cards.title: Car: Lane Detection Camera
cards.hint: AI learns lane marking patterns from video data to keep car centered.

cards.title: Car: Cruise Control Speed
cards.hint: Fixed rule: throttle maintains the car at the exact set speed.

cards.title: Smart TV: Recommendations
cards.hint: AI learns your watching preferences from viewing history to recommend shows.

cards.title: Smart TV: Remote Power Button
cards.reason: Needs a person to operate it
cards.hint: Manual button: sends a simple signal only when a person presses it.
